title: AndroidAPS is stopped when processing Medtronic pump history
symptom: AndroidAPS 2.8.2 is stopped every time the pump sends history, 100% reproducible since it started. The app restarts every time. The log shows an exception during parsing of history: org.joda.time.IllegalFieldValueException: Value 0 for dayOfMonth must be in the range [1,31].
cause: The problem was caused by a BGReceived512 entry in the pump history.
fix: The fix was merged via PR #448, which addressed the BGReceived512 entry issue. A hotfix branch was created based on master containing all 3 medtronic fixes.
evidence_quote: PR was merged, so this is fixed... Problem was BGReceived512 entry... It should work correctly now...
